company.shortDescription: Supr Daily provides an online subscription-based milk ordering platform designed to digitize existing milk delivery system.
company.description: Supr Daily provides an online subscription-based milk ordering platform designed to digitize existing milk delivery system. The company's platform offers a breakfast delivery application that helps users to add items to the cart and check it out before 10 pm, and get a box waiting outside the door the next morning, enabling users to browse and order dairy products and breakfast snacks online in a hassle-free way.

productsAndServices.description: An online platform that allows users to subscribe to daily milk deliveries, ensuring a consistent supply of milk to their doorstep.
productsAndServices.name: Milk Subscription Service
